hana (DevEx): onboarding blocked: samplekit publish failed CI due to a generated-package semver bump from typegen. @eli can you take a look?
eli (SDK): looking. preliminary: regendiff only touched comments and an example field name casing in openapi. typegen then added a changelog line -> version bumped. reproducer: `./scripts/regendiff packages/samplekit --base main`
pat (Eng): ouch. is this user-visible? if not we should suppress it.
eli (SDK): not user-facing. diff excerpt:
```
-    description: "Example event. // DO NOT REMOVE"
+    description: "Example event. // note: kept for clarity"
@@
-  - user_id
+  - userId
```
hana (DevEx): CI log: `semver-guard: detected version change 3.0.1 -> 3.1.0` so publish blocked.
pat (Eng): short-term: pin generated artifact version in samplekit/package.json to 3.0.1 so onboarding can continue. i'll open a hotfix PR and add a regen-lint CI step to fail earlier.
merge-bot: [publish] job failed on refs/heads/onboard/samplekit  reason: semver-check mismatch
eli (SDK): long-term: typegen should ignore whitespace/comment-only hunks and produce deterministic property ordering. i've got a draft PR to strip comment-only diffs from changelog generation: https://github.com/redwood-inference/typegen/pull/312 (WIP).
hana (DevEx): please also add a brief "regendiff noise" note in onboarding docs so new hires know the workaround. pat can you add it to the onboarding checklist?
pat (Eng): yep. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/samplekit/pull/462 (pins gen-version + regen-lint). merging after CI green.
eli (SDK): will follow up with tests for nondeterministic regendiff cases. ETA: tomorrow EOD.
hana (DevEx): thanks everyone. once merged i'll re-run the onboarding flow and confirm publish goes through
